properties.note: Cause established and verified fixed: the zombies were daemons spawn_daemon started and never waited for, left behind whenever one exited while its client ran. On main 293f957 a daemon stopped with --stop-shared stayed in state Z under its live client; after this change it leaves the process table (a_daemon_that_exits_is_not_left_a_zombie_of_the_client_that_started_it). Every other process reflow2 spawns is waited for.
